resources.string: Road Rooster is an offline three-lane arcade runner built around readable routes, lane hops, jumps, rooster dives, traffic crossings, Coins, Corn and Golden Eggs.
Every authored road is validated for a safe route. Cosmetics never change speed. Optional Road Aids are single-run items only: they do not create multipliers, combo chains or paid advantages.
Native Android and Kotlin game. The supplied farm-road design is the visual source of truth; missing production pieces were created specifically for Road Rooster.
Road Rooster does not require an account and does not send gameplay data to a server. The game contains no advertising, analytics, in-app purchases or cloud services.

Level progress, collected currency, Golden Eggs, achievement statistics, personal level records, unlocked cosmetics, Road Aid inventory and sound, music and vibration preferences are stored locally using Android DataStore.
The game does not access contacts, location, photos, camera or microphone. Vibration is used only when enabled for gameplay feedback.
You can erase all locally stored progress by clearing the app data in Android settings or uninstalling the game.
